## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

List the relevant checks and any unverified behavior.

## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, or `chore:`; add `!` for breaking changes).
- [ ] No tracking numbers, personal data, credentials, cookies, or tokens are included.
- [ ] New code is independently implemented and compatible with Apache-2.0.
- [ ] For carrier changes: access terms reviewed, no access-control bypass, and sanitized fixtures cover found/not-found responses.
- [ ] Carrier evidence is labeled as live shipment, dummy response, official-page observation, or synthetic assumption; reference URLs/commits and observation dates are included.
